description: Preview changes to a connected site's spam rules. Set dryRun to false to save them with write access. Saved rules affect future submissions. Omitted settings are preserved. A successful save returns the policy read back from storage.

allowedPhoneFormats.description: Accept a phone number when it matches any listed format. Supported formats: us-nanp, uk, au, eu, international, e164, any. US_NANP and E164 are accepted aliases. An empty list restores the single-format setting.

blockUrlsInMessage.description: Whether to block URLs and HTML anchor tags in messages.

blockedKeywords.description: Keywords or phrases that block a submission, matched without regard to case.

dryRun.description: Defaults to true. Set to false with account write access to save changes.

formType.description: Default form-type preset for this site.

maxUrls.description: Maximum allowed URLs when blockUrlsInMessage is false.

requiredKeywords.description: At least one listed phrase must appear in the message, matched without regard to case. An empty list disables this rule.

name: leadshield_configure_spam_policy
title: Preview or Save Site Screening Rules
